b.

Total number of flights

dbGetQuery(conn, "
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS number_of_flights
  FROM flights
")
  number_of_flights
1            336776

Number of flights for each carrier

dbGetQuery(conn, "
  SELECT carrier,
         COUNT(*) AS number_of_flights
  FROM flights
  GROUP BY carrier
  ORDER BY number_of_flights DESC
")

c.

Find the average departure delay (dep_delay)

dbGetQuery(conn, "
  SELECT AVG(dep_delay) AS average_departure_delay
  FROM flights
")
  average_departure_delay
1                12.63907

d.

Find the top 5 destinations (dest) With the most flights.

dbGetQuery(conn, "
  SELECT dest,
         COUNT(*) AS number_of_flights
  FROM flights
  GROUP BY dest
  ORDER BY number_of_flights DESC
  LIMIT 5
")
  dest number_of_flights
1  ORD             17283
2  ATL             17215
3  LAX             16174
4  BOS             15508
5  MCO             14082

e.

Create a table showing:

  • carrier

  • average arrival delay (arr_delay)

Sort the results from largest to smallest delay

dbGetQuery(conn, "
  SELECT carrier,
         AVG(arr_delay) AS average_arrival_delay
  FROM flights
  GROUP BY carrier
  ORDER BY average_arrival_delay DESC
")
